name: ssh-connection-sound
description: Plays sounds for Remote-SSH connection success, failure testing, and disconnect events.

sshConnectionSound.enabled.description: Enable or disable SSH connection sounds.

sshConnectionSound.soundsFile.description: Optional path to a custom sounds.json file. Leave empty to use the bundled configuration.

sshConnectionSound.pollInterval.description: Polling interval in milliseconds for detecting Remote-SSH state changes.

commands.title: SSH Connection Sound: Test Success Sound
SSH Connection Sound: Test Failure Sound
SSH Connection Sound: Test Disconnect Sound

scripts.check: node --check src/extension.js && node --check src/audio/player.js && node --check src/audio/linux.js && node --check src/audio/macos.js && node --check src/audio/windows.js && node --check src/config/loader.js && node --check src/remote/monitor.js
